name: VoxCeleb Speaker Recognition Challenge 2022
description: This report describes the submission system of the GIST-AiTeR team at the 2022 VoxCeleb Speaker Recognition Challenge (VoxSRC) Track 4. Our system mainly includes speech enhancement, voice activity detection , multi-scaled speaker embedding, probabilistic linear discriminant analysis-based speaker clustering, and overlapped speech detection models. We first construct four different diarization systems according to different model combinations with the best experimental efforts. Our final submission is an ensemble system of all the four systems and achieves a diarization error rate of 5.12% on the challenge evaluation set, ranked third at the diarization track of the challenge.
reputation: A challenge benchmark from the VoxSRC speaker recognition series, which is widely used in the speaker diarization community.
notes: Non-LLM speech benchmark; performance is typically reported as DER and can vary with clustering, VAD, and overlap handling. Challenge-style evaluation and dataset-specific tuning are common.
